name: bluey2_state_oracle
description: State-only US 1.1 Bluey 2 oracle. Both runners follow the proven one-player Tracks route to Ancient Lake; a narrow level_load argument override retargets only that gameplay load to the Bluey rematch (course 52). Every racer is sampled after presentation and racer index 1 (Bluey, vehicle 6) is joined on the race clock. Original two-field simulation is the reference. Enhanced one-field simulation is retained as a positive control that reproduces the reported faster-boss behavior; it is not the shipping default.

threshold_basis.state_max_position_p95: docs/BLUEY2_PARITY.md records 109.403882 for the passing 1.0.3 Original arm; 130.0 is that plus 18.8% headroom and stays 40x under the 5186.824 Enhanced control.
threshold_basis.state_max_position_error: UNMEASURED: no recorded worst-case exists, only the p95. 1000.0 is 9.1x the recorded p95 and still rejects the Enhanced control, whose p95 alone is 5186.824.
threshold_basis.state_min_progress_agreement: docs/BLUEY2_PARITY.md records 97.266881% passing against 8.671922% for the Enhanced control.
threshold_basis.state_min_rng_agreement: UNMEASURED: no recorded rng agreement exists for this lane. The comparison still fails closed when either trace carries no non-zero seed, which is the way this measurement can go vacuous.
threshold_basis.state_max_velocity_ratio_deviation: docs/BLUEY2_PARITY.md records a 1.000646 mean-object-speed ratio, a 0.065% deviation; 0.02 is 31x that headroom and the 1.139822 Enhanced control sits 7x outside it.

ares_phase_offsets.basis: Inherited from the proven one-player Tracks route through the point where its gameplay load is retargeted.
